title: Data Privacy Consent (RA 10173)
text: I authorize IRBY Dental Clinic to collect, record, store and process my personal and sensitive personal information, including my photograph, dental chart, clinical photos and treatment and billing records, for the purpose of providing dental care, keeping my records, scheduling my follow-up visits and billing. My information will be kept confidential, accessed only by authorized clinic staff, and handled in accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). I may request access to, correction of, or a copy of my records at any time.
checkboxLabel: Patient consent verified: the patient has read and agreed to the data privacy consent above, and the signed form is on file.
